$comment: Single source of truth for what lives in this monorepo and what CI may run.
* Every top-level project directory MUST have exactly one entry here.
* A check is only ever set to `true` after it has been observed passing.
Flipping a flag optimistically is how a repository ends up with red
* Every `false` carries a `notes` string explaining the blocker.

projects.notes: No lint or test script defined.
Vue 3 SPA, plain JavaScript. lint migrated from .eslintrc.cjs to flat config for ESLint 10 and observed clean; the check-only form is lint, the mutating one is lint:fix. No test script.

Clean-architecture implementation with 42 unit tests. install, lint, build and test each observed passing from a clean checkout before these flags were set. ESLint runs on flat config; Cypress is not wired into CI and its binary download is skipped.

Nuxt 4 with six numbered layers, each a step in the same refactor. Declares pnpm@9.15.5 and commits pnpm-lock.yaml, and CI honours both: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` verifies the lockfile as well as installing from it. All four checks pass: 363 lint errors and a test suite that could not start were both traced to dependencies the project used but never declared - typescript, without which @nuxt/eslint-config silently treats it as a JavaScript project, and a vitest 3 stack that cannot drive nuxt 4's vite 8. 104 tests pass, 4 skipped by the author.

Angular CLI 22 requires Node >= 22.22.3, so this project pins Node 24. Build verified on Node 24 after pinning TypeScript to ~6 (compiler-cli peer range is >=6.0 <6.1), switching moduleResolution to bundler so Material's exports map resolves, completing the Tailwind v4 migration, and opting the five NgModule-declared components out of standalone.

@astrojs/check@0.9.10 peers typescript@^5||^6 while this project runs ^7.0.2, so npm ci needs --legacy-peer-deps (recorded in installFlags). Same family as the typescript hold: the tool has not widened for TS 7 yet. Tracked in issue #1289.

SvelteKit with Lucia-style sessions and Google OAuth via arctic. $env/static/private inlines secrets at build time, so the build needs every name in .env.example present - the values in env are placeholders, not credentials, and the artefact is discarded. The same names are what `svelte-kit sync` reads to generate the $env/static/public declarations, so typecheck needs them too. test stays off: `npm test` chains test:e2e, which wants Playwright browsers and a seeded database, and it shells out to pnpm, which this project does not install with.

prebuild runs prisma generate, which needs no database. Prisma is on 7 with the pg driver adapter (ADR 0004); schema push and a live query were verified against a local Postgres 16. lint stays off and is blocked upstream: eslint-config-next 16.3.2 declares eslint >=9.0.0 but bundles typescript-eslint 8, whose parser throws "scopeManager.addGlobals is not a function" against eslint 10. The config itself is migrated and correct, so the check flips the day that resolves.

React Native clean architecture with inversify. react-native-fast-image@8.6.3 peers react ^17||^18 against react 19, so npm ci needs --legacy-peer-deps (issue #1289). RN 0.87 does not support Babel 8 or jest 30 despite declaring permissive peers, so both are pinned to what its preset actually requires. lint is blocked upstream: @react-native/eslint-config 0.87 bundles a parser that throws "scopeManager.addGlobals is not a function" on eslint 10. test is blocked on inversify property injection, which Babel now rejects - constructor injection would fix it.
Frontend of the Flask app. The Python API alongside it is not yet covered by CI.

The Engineering Atlas. Nuxt 4 + Nuxt Content. better-sqlite3 13 sits outside @nuxt/content's peerOptional ^12.5.0, so npm ci needs --legacy-peer-deps (recorded in installFlags). That combination was verified by running the built server, not just by building it - see docs/DEPENDENCIES.md. Tracked in issue #1289.
build runs tsc. A `typecheck` script is also available.

NestJS SOLID demonstrations. Prisma 7 with the better-sqlite3 driver adapter (ADR 0004); prebuild runs prisma generate, which needs no database. typescript held at ^6 (issue #1296). lint migrated to ESLint 10 flat config and observed clean; test is jest, 1 suite passing.

Express 5 + TypeORM + tsyringe. typescript held at ^6: ts-node needs the programmatic compiler API removed in TS 7, so the dev server and jest both die on import (issue #1296). npm ci still needs --legacy-peer-deps for eslint-config-airbnb-base@15, which peers eslint ^7||^8 against this project's eslint 10 (issue #1289). build and test stay off: four TypeORM repositories still call getRepository, removed in TypeORM 0.3.

Bun + Hono + Postgres. Registered under the bun ecosystem so Dependabot writes bun.lock. lint is biome, check-only (22 files, 2 infos, exit 0); the mutating form lives in lint:fix so CI checks rather than rewrites. test is a real integration suite: it shells out to drizzle db:push and truncates the table between cases, so CI starts the runner's PostgreSQL and creates the database named in the postgres field. 4 tests, 8 assertions, verified against a live Postgres 16. .env.test is gitignored and unnecessary - the env block below is what supplies DATABASE_URL, and the suite passes with the file absent.
Single-file operational script; no build step.
Umbrella entry. The three Poetry projects beneath it — backend, frontend and pipelines — carry their own manifest entries and CI checks.
Streamlit UI. install runs `poetry check --lock` then `poetry install`; 6 tests pass. No build step and no linter configured.

Ingestion pipeline. install verified (~3.5 min; the torch/transformers tree is ~5.7 GB). test stays off: test_milvus_connector_collection_creation needs a live Milvus server, and test_markdown_processor fails with KeyError: 'title'. Both predate CI coverage.
FastAPI service. install verified (~3 min). test stays off because tests/test_app.py and tests/test_models.py are both empty files — pytest collects nothing and exits 5.
Flask API. Its own manifest entry is solid-flask-web-app/api; the frontend is covered separately as solid-flask-web-app/ui.

Flask API, pip + setuptools rather than Poetry. Python 3.13 to match Dockerfile.api. mysqlclient builds from source, so it needs MySQL client headers — declared in systemPackages. install, ruff and 75 tests all observed passing before these flags were set. No build step; the service runs from source.

Six Spring/Java modules behind an aggregator pom.xml. build runs `mvn -B -DskipTests package`, test runs `mvn -B verify` (4 tests, all in patient-service). billing/clinical/scheduling are domain-only modules — entity, repository port and use case, Lombok and the JDK only — so their POMs are plain Java libraries rather than Spring Boot applications.
